# Defuddle

`defuddle.js` is the browser bundle from Defuddle 0.18.1:

- Source: https://github.com/kepano/defuddle
- Commit inspected: `51c181d03e4eaa6d6cfa72a6a00eaeb6d5ae5202`
- License: MIT, retained in `defuddle.LICENSE`

The AI Brain extension loads it only on YouTube pages to obtain existing
caption transcripts when the primary UseTranscribe service is unavailable.
